_comment: ai_ops hooks template. Copy content into .claude/settings.local.json at workspace root. SessionStart is read-only; PreToolUse is advisory. The dynamic PostToolUse npx Markdown hook is intentionally disabled pending an integrity-controlled local replacement.

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '(00_Admin/(policies|specs|configs)/|AGENTS\.md|CONTRIBUTING\.md|\.ai_ops/workflows/)'; then echo "[GOVERNANCE GUARD] Level 4 path detected: $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH — verify explicit L4 approval exists before proceeding."; fi; exit 0

echo "{\"additionalContext\": \"Branch: $(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo none). Active artifacts: $(grep -c 'type:' ai_ops/.ai_ops/local/work_state.yaml 2>/dev/null || echo 0) in work_state.yaml.\"}"
